messages:
sam: Putting a design question up for quick review: we're adding a bulk-label + reason flow to Prompt Evals so reviewers can tag results (e.g., 'spam', 'hallucination', 'good') in batch and optionally provide a reason. Proto: https://files.redwood/s/bulk-label-proto. Need UX microcopy, keyboard flow, and a11y checks. Main Qs: should reason be required for certain labels? Should we show a compact inline 'reason' input in the floating action bar or surface a modal? Also debate whether 'Reject' vs 'Mark as bad' is clearer in the UI.

elaine: From a scanning + density POV I prefer modal for multi-line reasons (keeps inline rows compact) but an inline single-line quick-reason field in the floating bar is great for short tags. Suggest hybrid: floating bar has a small 'Add reason' pill that expands an inline single-line input; if the user types more than ~120 chars or presses Enter+Shift, promote to modal for extended notes.

jon: Implementation notes: inline input is cheapest. Modal has heavier accessibility and focus-trap work but is better for long-form text. Also backend: require reason on certain labels (e.g., 'hallucination') is trivial to validate server-side. We'll need to surface server validation errors in the action bar inline to avoid losing context.

mira: UXR insight: reviewers sometimes add reasons for analytics; however forcing reason on many labels slows triage. Suggest make reason optional for 'good' and 'spam', required for 'hallucination' and 'policy-violation'. We can A/B test requiring reason for unambiguous vs ambiguous labels.

aria: A11y rules and suggestions:
- Floating action bar approach OK if it appears in DOM after the list (so tab order remains: filters -> list -> action bar). If it reorders DOM, keyboard users get confused.
- Inline reason input needs aria-label="Reason for label" and aria-describedby pointing to a short helper text: "Optional, press Shift+Enter for more".
- If we auto-promote to modal, ensure a clear announcement: aria-live polite: "Reason editor opened" and focus moves into the modal textarea.
- Required-reason validation must expose clear inline errors and be programmatically associated with the offending control (aria-invalid + aria-describedby).
- For bulk operations with many items, announce progress and completion with aria-live assertive: "Bulk labeling complete: 120 results labeled".

elaine: Microcopy suggestions:
- Action bar button: "Label selected" (primary)
- Quick reason placeholder: "Add a reason (optional)"
- Modal heading: "Provide label reason"
- Required-reason error: "Reason required for this label"
- For negative labels prefer 'Reject' vs 'Mark as bad'  'Reject' maps to workflows and is more concise. Use 'Mark as regression' where appropriate for eval diffs.

sam: Decisions so far for handoff:
1) Hybrid UI: floating/sticky action bar with visible label dropdown, count chip, and an inline single-line reason input (placeholder 'Add a reason (optional)').
2) If user expands the reason (via Shift+Enter or an 'expand' affordance) open a modal editor with full textarea and guidance.
3) Labels 'hallucination' and 'policy-violation' require a reason; others optional. Server-side validation returns inline error shown in the bar.
4) CTA text: 'Label selected' when multiple labels apply; single-row quick action uses 'Label' on hover pill. Negative flow to use verb 'Reject' where semantics apply.
5) Accessibility: keep action bar after list in DOM, aria labels and live announcements for open/complete events, focus trap for modal, inline error associations.

jon: I'll prototype the inline reason input and the promote-to-modal behavior. I'll also add optimistic UI for the label action with progress indicator in the floating bar. For bulk > 50 items we'll switch to a batched job with a toast linking to job status page.

mira: I'll run a quick unmoderated test with reviewers to validate friction for required reasons vs optional. Would like to test the threshold at which users prefer modal vs inline.

aria: A11y checklist I'll add to PR:
- Tab order verification (filters -> list -> action bar)
- Inline input has aria-label and helper description
- Modal has role=dialog, aria-labelledby, initial focus, and Escape to close
- Bulk completion announced assertively
- Error messages programmatically associated

upload-bot: uploaded two artifacts: bulk_label_bar.png and reason_modal.sketch (https://files.redwood/s/bulk-label-proto)

sam: Thanks all 44d. Action items: @elaine update mocks with hybrid behavior & microcopy, @jon spike inline+modal and batched fallback, @mira run quick test, @aria finalize a11y checklist. If we see usability regression in tests, we can flip required-reason labels to optional and revisit.
